wk-msr.label: Kolkata Knight Riders' keepers' batting strike rate, 2018–2026
wk-msr.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
wk-msr.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, i.batting_team_id team, d.batter_id pid, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, COUNT(DISTINCT d.innings_id) inns FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2018 GROUP BY year, team, pid
